speaker: abel_garnish
text: James has been spending. Mind the posts. They are marble until they are dry.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Behind the arras. Every part of the king's in rolls, tied and named, and the plot ruled on its pasteboard.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Nobody here has wasted August but you. Gaunt.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Six weeks to get a dying man's England by heart.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In another man's hand. My own lines, and I would not know them in the street.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: You would know them in the street. You would not know them on the stage, which is why you have the roll.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The king's roll would reach from here to the Curtain. Burbage had it on Monday.
